properties.description:

* WHERE...A portion of southern Connecticut, including the following
county, Fairfield.

* WHEN...Until 1130 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

- At 919 AM EDT, Flooding from previous heavy rainfall is
ongoing in the warned area. Between 3 and 5 inches of rain
have fallen.

Danbury, Ridgefield, Bethel and Brookfield.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
